TARGET_URL = "https://corp.sec.state.ma.us/CorpWeb/CorpSearch/CorpSearch.aspx"
BASE_URL = "https://corp.sec.state.ma.us/"
GRID_SELECTOR = "#MainContent_SearchControl_grdSearchResultsEntity"
ROW_SELECTOR = GRID_SELECTOR + " tr.GridRow, " + GRID_SELECTOR + " tr.GridAltRow"
DETAIL_LINK_SELECTOR = GRID_SELECTOR + " a[href*='CorpSummary.aspx']"


def log(message):
    print(f"[{datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}] {message}", flush=True)


def sanitize_cell_value(val, max_len=32000):
    if val is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(val, (dict, list)):
        s = json.dumps(val, ensure_ascii=False)
    else:
        s = str(val)
    if len(s) > max_len:
        return s[:max_len - 35] + "... [TRUNCATED_EXCEL_LIMIT]"
    return s


def clean(value):
    if value is None or pd.isna(value) or str(value).strip().lower() in ("", "nan", "none", "null"):
        return ""
    try:
        if pd.isna(value):
            return ""
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        pass
    text = str(value).replace("\xa0", " ").strip()
    if text.lower() in {"", "nan", "none", "null"}:
        return ""
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)


def value_from_row(row, key):
    return clean(row.get(key, ""))


def canonical_product_id(url):
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    value = parse_qs(parsed.query).get("sysvalue", [""])[0].strip()
    if value:
        return value
    return hashlib.sha256(url.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24]


def detect_anti_bot_signals(status, html):
    markers = (
        "cloudflare turnstile", "cf-browser-verification", "ray id:",
        "just a moment...", "datadome", "perimeterx", "px-captcha",
        "distil networks", "press & hold", "incapsula", "_incapsula_resource",
        "imperva", "incident id", "kasada", "akamai", "shieldsquare",
        "security challenge", "pardon our interruption", "potential security risk",
        "detected automated scripts", "additional security check", "i am human",
        "hcaptcha", "access denied", "robot or human"
    )
    text = (html or "").lower()
    return "Blocked by bot protection" if status in {403, 429} or any(x in text for x in markers) else ""


def mask_reviewer_pii(text):
    text = clean(text)
    text = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "***@***.***", text)

    def mask_name(match):
        parts = match.group(0).split()
        return " ".join(f"{part[0]}***" if i == 0 else f"{part[0]}." for i, part in enumerate(parts))

    return re.sub(r"\b[A-Z][a-z]+\s+[A-Z][a-z]+\b", mask_name, text)


def table_text(soup, selector):
    table = soup.select_one(selector)
    return clean(" ".join(table.stripped_strings)) if table else ""


def labeled_value(text, patterns):
    text = clean(text)
    for pattern in patterns:
        match = re.search(pattern, text, re.I)
        if match:
            return clean(match.group(1))
    return ""


def principal_office(soup):
    table = soup.select_one("#MainContent_tblPrincipleOffice")
    if not table:
        return ""
    values = []
    labels = {"address", "city", "state", "zip", "country", "principal office", "principal office address"}
    for row in table.select("tr"):
        cells = [clean(" ".join(c.stripped_strings)) for c in row.select("th, td")]
        cells = [x for x in cells if x]
        if len(cells) >= 2 and cells[0].lower().rstrip(":") in labels:
            values.extend(cells[1:])
        elif len(cells) == 1 and not values:
            values.append(cells[0])
    return clean(" ".join(values)) or table_text(soup, "#MainContent_tblPrincipleOffice")


def extract_detail(html, url, source_listing_url, mask_reviews):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html or "", "html.parser")
    name_text = table_text(soup, "#MainContent_tblEntity")
    type_text = table_text(soup, "#MainContent_tblEntityType")
    id_text = table_text(soup, "#MainContent_tblIDNumber")
    entity_name = labeled_value(name_text, [r"summary\s+for\s*:\s*(.+)$", r"entity\s+name\s*:\s*(.+)$"])
    entity_name = entity_name or name_text
    entity_type = labeled_value(type_text, [r"entity\s+type\s*:\s*(.+)$", r"type\s*:\s*(.+)$"]) or type_text
    id_number = labeled_value(id_text, [r"identification\s+number\s*:\s*(.+)$", r"id\s+number\s*:\s*(.+)$"]) or id_text
    office = principal_office(soup)
    status = table_text(soup, "#MainContent_tblStatus")
    status = labeled_value(status, [r"current\s+status\s*:\s*(.+)$", r"status\s*:\s*(.+)$"]) or status
    if mask_reviews:
        entity_name = mask_reviewer_pii(entity_name)
        entity_type = mask_reviewer_pii(entity_type)
        office = mask_reviewer_pii(office)
    return {
        "product_id": canonical_product_id(url),
        "product_url": url,
        "source_listing_url": source_listing_url or "DIRECT_INPUT",
        "Entity Name": entity_name,
        "ID Number": id_number,
        "Entity Type": entity_type,
        "Principal Office Address": office,
        "Current Status": status,
        "Entity Detail URL": url,
    }


async def dismiss_cookie_banner(page):
    for selector in ("button:has-text('Accept')", "button:has-text('Allow all')", "button:has-text('I agree')", "[id*='cookie' i] button", "[class*='cookie' i] button"):
        locator = page.locator(selector).first
        try:
            if await locator.is_visible(timeout=500):
                await locator.click(timeout=1500)
                return
        except Exception:
            continue


async def safe_click(page, locator, selector, flags, url):
    try:
        await locator.click(timeout=7000)
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        log(f"Click blocked on locator '{selector}': {exc}")
        flags.append({"Type": "Click Intercepted", "URL": url, "Message": f"Element {selector} blocked: {str(exc)[:200]}"})
        try:
            await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
            await dismiss_cookie_banner(page)
            await locator.click(timeout=2500)
            return True
        except Exception:
            try:
                await locator.evaluate("el => el.click()")
                return True
            except Exception as fallback_exc:
                log(f"Click fallback failed on locator '{selector}': {fallback_exc}")
                flags.append({"Type": "Error", "URL": url, "Message": str(fallback_exc)[:300]})
                return False


async def goto_checked(page, url, flags):
    try:
        response = await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
    except Exception as exc:
        flags.append({"Type": "Error", "URL": url, "Message": str(exc)[:300]})
        return None, ""
    await dismiss_cookie_banner(page)
    html = await page.content()
    blocked = detect_anti_bot_signals(response.status if response else 0, html)
    if blocked:
        flags.append({"Type": blocked, "URL": page.url, "Message": blocked})
        log(f"{blocked}: {page.url}")
        return response, blocked
    return response, html


async def get_detail(page, url, source_listing_url, mask_reviews, flags):
    response, html = await goto_checked(page, url, flags)
    if html == "Blocked by bot protection":
        return None, True
    if not html:
        return None, False
    return extract_detail(html, page.url, source_listing_url, mask_reviews), False


async def wait_for_grid_change(page, old_signature):
    try:
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle", timeout=30000)
    except PlaywrightTimeoutError:
        pass
    await page.wait_for_selector(GRID_SELECTOR, timeout=30000)
    for _ in range(40):
        current = await page.locator(GRID_SELECTOR).inner_text()
        if current != old_signature:
            return True
        await page.wait_for_timeout(250)
    return False


async def extract_listing(page, listing_url, keyword, limit, mask_reviews, flags):
    response, html = await goto_checked(page, listing_url, flags)
    if html == "Blocked by bot protection":
        return [], True, 0, 0
    if not html:
        return [], False, 0, 0
    try:
        await page.wait_for_selector("#MainContent_rdoByEntityName", timeout=20000)
        radio = page.locator("#MainContent_rdoByEntityName")
        if not await radio.is_checked():
            await radio.check()
        if keyword:
            await page.locator("#MainContent_txtEntityName").fill(keyword)
        await page.locator("#MainContent_ddBeginsWithEntityName").select_option("B")
        submit = page.locator("#MainContent_btnSearch")
        if not await safe_click(page, submit, "#MainContent_btnSearch", flags, page.url):
            return [], False, 0, 0
        await page.wait_for_selector(GRID_SELECTOR, timeout=30000)
    except Exception as exc:
        flags.append({"Type": "Error", "URL": page.url, "Message": f"Search failed: {str(exc)[:300]}"})
        return [], False, 0, 0

    records = []
    links_discovered = 0
    links_processed = 0
    seen = set()
    detail_page = await page.context.new_page()
    try:
        while len(records) < limit:
            grid = page.locator(GRID_SELECTOR)
            signature = await grid.inner_text()
            if signature in seen:
                break
            seen.add(signature)
            rows = page.locator(ROW_SELECTOR)
            page_links = []
            for i in range(await rows.count()):
                row = rows.nth(i)
                link = row.locator("a[href*='CorpSummary.aspx']").first
                if await link.count() == 0:
                    continue
                href = await link.get_attribute("href")
                if not href:
                    continue
                cells = row.locator("td")
                values = [clean(await cells.nth(j).inner_text()) for j in range(await cells.count())]
                page_links.append((urljoin(page.url, href), clean(await link.inner_text()), values))
            links_discovered += len(page_links)
            for detail_url, listing_name, values in page_links:
                if len(records) >= limit:
                    break
                record, halted = await get_detail(detail_page, detail_url, page.url, mask_reviews, flags)
                links_processed += 1
                if halted:
                    return records, True, links_discovered, links_processed
                if record:
                    record["Entity Name"] = record["Entity Name"] or listing_name
                    record["ID Number"] = record["ID Number"] or (values[0] if values else "")
                    record["Principal Office Address"] = record["Principal Office Address"] or (values[-1] if values else "")
                    records.append(record)
            if len(records) >= limit:
                break
            next_link = None
            anchors = page.locator(GRID_SELECTOR + " a")
            for i in range(await anchors.count()):
                anchor = anchors.nth(i)
                href = (await anchor.get_attribute("href") or "").lower()
                text = clean(await anchor.inner_text()).lower()
                if "page$" in href and (text == "next" or text.isdigit()):
                    next_link = anchor
                    break
            if next_link is None or not await safe_click(page, next_link, GRID_SELECTOR + " a", flags, page.url):
                break
            if not await wait_for_grid_change(page, signature):
                break
    finally:
        await detail_page.close()
    return records, False, links_discovered, links_processed


async def run(args, input_df):
    records, flags = [], []
    categories = len(input_df.to_dict("records"))
    links_discovered = links_processed = 0
    status, title, halted = 0, "", False
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=args.headless, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"])
        context = await browser.new_context(user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/124 Safari/537.36", viewport={"width": 1920, "height": 1080})
        await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); window.chrome = { runtime: {} };")
        await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', {get: () => undefined}); window.chrome = {runtime: {}};")
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            for row in input_df.to_dict("records"):
                if args.max_products is not None and len(records) >= args.max_products:
                    break
                detail_url = value_from_row(row, "detail_url")
                listing_url = value_from_row(row, "listing_url") or TARGET_URL
                keyword = value_from_row(row, "keyword")
                remaining = args.max_products - len(records) if args.max_products is not None else 10**9
                if detail_url:
                    detail_page = await context.new_page()
                    try:
                        record, halted = await get_detail(detail_page, urljoin(BASE_URL, detail_url), "DIRECT_INPUT", args.mask_reviews, flags)
                        links_discovered += 1
                        links_processed += 1
                        if record:
                            records.append(record)
                    finally:
                        await detail_page.close()
                else:
                    found, halted, discovered, processed = await extract_listing(page, listing_url, keyword, remaining, args.mask_reviews, flags)
                    records.extend(found)
                    links_discovered += discovered
                    links_processed += processed
                if halted:
                    break
            status = 200
            title = await page.title()
            if not records:
                try:
                    await page.screenshot(path="diagnostic_screenshot.png", full_page=True)
                except Exception as exc:
                    flags.append({"Type": "Error", "URL": page.url, "Message": f"Screenshot failed: {str(exc)[:200]}"})
        finally:
            await browser.close()
    return records, flags, categories, links_discovered, links_processed, halted, status, title


def write_output(records, flags, output_path, source_workbook=None):
    output = Path(output_path)
    source = Path(source_workbook) if source_workbook else None
    if output.exists():
        workbook = load_workbook(output)
    elif source and source.exists():
        workbook = load_workbook(source)
    else:
        workbook = Workbook()
    old_headers = []
    if "Extracted Data" in workbook.sheetnames:
        old_headers = [cell.value for cell in workbook["Extracted Data"][1] if cell.value]
        del workbook["Extracted Data"]
    if "Flags" in workbook.sheetnames:
        del workbook["Flags"]
    data_ws = workbook.create_sheet("Extracted Data", 0)
    flags_ws = workbook.create_sheet("Flags", 1)
    standard = ["product_id", "product_url", "source_listing_url", "Entity Name", "ID Number", "Entity Type", "Principal Office Address", "Current Status", "Entity Detail URL"]
    columns = standard + [x for x in old_headers if x not in standard]
    safe_records = [{key: sanitize_cell_value(value) for key, value in record.items()} for record in records]
    data_ws.append(columns)
    for record in safe_records:
        data_ws.append([sanitize_cell_value(record.get(column, "")) for column in columns])
    flags_ws.append(["Type", "URL", "Message"])
    for flag in flags:
        flags_ws.append([sanitize_cell_value(flag.get(k, "")) for k in ("Type", "URL", "Message")])
    workbook.save(output_path)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Massachusetts corporations scraper")
    parser.add_argument("--input", default="input.xlsx")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="output.xlsx")
    parser.add_argument("--max-products", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--headless", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=True)
    parser.add_argument("--mask-reviews", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        sheets = pd.read_excel(args.input, sheet_name=None)
        sheets = {k: v.fillna("") for k, v in sheets.items()}
        input_df = sheets.get("Extracted Data") or next(iter(sheets.values()), pd.DataFrame())
    except FileNotFoundError:
        input_df = pd.DataFrame([{"keyword": "mobius"}])
        log(f"Input file {args.input} was not found; using keyword 'mobius'.")
    except Exception as exc:
        log(f"Unable to read input workbook: {exc}")
        sys.exit(1)
    try:
        records, flags, categories, discovered, processed, halted, status, title = asyncio.run(run(args, input_df))
    except Exception as exc:
        log(f"Fatal crawl error: {exc}")
        records, flags, categories, discovered, processed, halted, status, title = [], [{"Type": "Error", "URL": TARGET_URL, "Message": str(exc)[:500]}], len(input_df), 0, 0, False, 0, ""
    log(f"Crawl Funnel: {categories} categories, {discovered} links discovered, {processed} processed, {len(records)} extracted.")
    if halted and any(x.get("Type") == "Blocked by bot protection" for x in flags):
        write_output(records, flags, args.output, args.input)
        sys.exit(1)
    if not records:
        safe_title = clean(title)
        flags.append({"Type": "Error", "URL": TARGET_URL, "Message": f"No product records found: HTTP {status}, Title: '{safe_title}', Screenshot: diagnostic_screenshot.png"})
        log(f"No product records found: HTTP {status}, Title: '{safe_title}', Screenshot: diagnostic_screenshot.png")
        log("ERROR: Zero product records were extracted. Aborting.")
        write_output(records, flags, args.output, args.input)
        sys.exit(1)
    required = ["product_id", "product_url", "source_listing_url", "Entity Name", "ID Number", "Entity Type", "Principal Office Address", "Current Status", "Entity Detail URL"]
    for record in records:
        for field in required:
            if not clean(record.get(field)):
                flags.append({"Type": "Missing Field", "URL": record.get("product_url", ""), "Message": f"Missing {field}"})
    write_output(records, flags, args.output, args.input)
    log(f"Wrote {len(records)} records to {args.output}.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def add_flag(flag_type, url, message):

def sanitize_cell_value(val, max_len=32000):
    if val is None:
        return ''
    if isinstance(val, (dict, list)):
        s = json.dumps(val, ensure_ascii=False)
    else:
        s = str(val)
    if len(s) > max_len:
        return s[:max_len - 35] + '... [TRUNCATED_EXCEL_LIMIT]'
    return s


def clean(value):
    if value is None or pd.isna(value) or str(value).strip().lower() in ("", "nan", "none", "null"):
        return ""
    try:

            return ''
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        pass
    value = str(value).strip()
    return '' if value.lower() in {'nan', 'none', 'null'} else value


def value_from_row(row, name):

    markers = (
        'cloudflare turnstile', 'cf-browser-verification', 'ray id:', 'just a moment...',
        'datadome', 'perimeterx', 'px-captcha', 'distil networks', 'press & hold',

    specs = {}
    table = soup.select_one('table.table-striped')
    if not table:
        return specs
    for row in table.select('tr'):
        cells = row.select('th, td')
        if len(cells) >= 2:
            key = cells[0].get_text(' ', strip=True)
            value = cells[1].get_text(' ', strip=True)
            if key:
                specs[key] = value
    return specs


def extract_detail(soup, url, source_listing_url, mask_reviews=True):
    container = soup.select_one('article.product_page') or soup
    title_node = container.select_one('h1')
    title = title_node.get_text(' ', strip=True) if title_node else ''
    price_node = container.select_one('.product_main .price_color') or container.select_one('.price_color')
    price = extract_price(price_node)
    availability_node = container.select_one('.availability')
    availability = availability_node.get_text(' ', strip=True) if availability_node else ''
    rating_node = container.select_one('.star-rating')
    rating = ''
    if rating_node:
        classes = rating_node.get('class', [])
        rating = next((item for item in classes if item.lower() != 'star-rating'), '')
        if not rating:
            rating = rating_node.get_text(' ', strip=True)
    heading = soup.find(id='product_description')
    description = ''
    if heading:
        paragraph = heading.find_next('p')
        description = paragraph.get_text(' ', strip=True) if paragraph else ''
    description = description[:300]
    specs = get_specifications(soup)
    upc = specs.get('UPC', '')
    if not title:
        add_flag('Missing field', url, 'title')
    if not price:
        add_flag('Missing field', url, 'price')
    if not availability:
        add_flag('Missing field', url, 'availability')
    if not upc:
        add_flag('Low-confidence extraction', url, 'UPC missing; URL slug fallback used for product_id')
    if 'in stock' not in availability.lower():
        return None
    canonical = urljoin(url, soup.select_one('link[rel="canonical"]')['href']) if soup.select_one('link[rel="canonical"]') and soup.select_one('link[rel="canonical"]').get('href') else url
    record = {
        'product_id': canonical_product_id(canonical, upc),
        'title': title,
        'price': price,
        'availability': availability,
        'rating': rating,
        'product_url': canonical,
        'source_listing_url': source_listing_url,
        'description': mask_reviewer_pii(description) if mask_reviews else description,
    }
    return record


def fetch(session, url):
    log(f'Fetching {url}')
    response = session.get(url, timeout=30)
    if detect_anti_bot_signals(response):
        raise RuntimeError('Blocked by bot protection')
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response


def discover_links(session, listing_url, keyword=''):
    links = []
    visited_pages = set()
    current = listing_url
    while current and current not in visited_pages:
        visited_pages.add(current)
        response = fetch(session, current)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
        for card in soup.select('article.product_pod'):
            anchor = card.select_one('h3 a')
            if not anchor or not anchor.get('href'):
                continue
            detail = urljoin(response.url, anchor['href'])
            card_title = anchor.get('title', '') or anchor.get_text(' ', strip=True)
            haystack = f'{card_title} {urlparse(detail).path}'.lower()
            if keyword and keyword.lower() not in haystack:
                continue
            stock = card.select_one('.instock')
            if stock and 'in stock' not in stock.get_text(' ', strip=True).lower():
                continue
            if detail not in links:
                links.append(detail)
        next_anchor = soup.select_one('.next a')
        current = urljoin(response.url, next_anchor['href']) if next_anchor and next_anchor.get('href') else None
    return links


async def diagnostic_screenshot(url, status, html, headless=True):
    try:
        from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
        async with async_playwright() as playwright:
            browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=headless, args=['--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled', '--no-sandbox'])
            context = await browser.new_context(user_agent=USER_AGENT, viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080})
            await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); window.chrome = { runtime: {} };")
            await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); window.chrome = { runtime: {} };")
            await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); window.chrome = { runtime: {} };")
            page = await context.new_page()
            await page.goto(url, wait_until='domcontentloaded', timeout=30000)
            await dismiss_cookie_banner(page)
            await page.screenshot(path='diagnostic_screenshot.png', full_page=True)
            title = await page.title()
            await browser.close()
            log(f"No product records found: HTTP {status}, Title: '{title}', Screenshot: diagnostic_screenshot.png")
    except Exception as exc:
        safe = BeautifulSoup(html or '', 'html.parser')
        title = safe_title(safe)
        log(f"No product records found: HTTP {status}, Title: '{title}', Screenshot: diagnostic_screenshot.png; screenshot error: {exc}")


def click_blocked(selector, url, exc):
    log(f"Click blocked on locator '{selector}': {exc}")
    add_flag('Click Intercepted', url, f'Element {selector} blocked: {str(exc)[:200]}')


def export_results(records, output):
    columns = ['product_id', 'title', 'price', 'availability', 'rating', 'product_url', 'source_listing_url', 'description']
    data = [{key: sanitize_cell_value(row.get(key, '')) for key in columns} for row in records]
    flags = [{key: sanitize_cell_value(row.get(key, '')) for key in ('Type', 'URL', 'Message')} for row in FLAGS]
    with pd.ExcelWriter(output, engine='openpyxl') as writer:
        pd.DataFrame(data, columns=columns).to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Extracted Data', index=False)
        pd.DataFrame(flags, columns=['Type', 'URL', 'Message']).to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Flags', index=False)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', default='input.xlsx')
    parser.add_argument('--output', default='output.xlsx')
    parser.add_argument('--max-products', type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument('--headless', action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=True)
    parser.add_argument('--mask-reviews', action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        input_df = pd.read_excel(args.input).fillna('')
    except FileNotFoundError:
        input_df = pd.DataFrame([{}])
        log(f'Input file {args.input} not found; using default target.')
    except Exception as exc:
        add_flag('Error', args.input, f'Could not read input workbook: {exc}')
        input_df = pd.DataFrame([{}])
    if input_df.empty:
        input_df = pd.DataFrame([{}])
    session = requests.Session()
    session.headers.update({'User-Agent': USER_AGENT, 'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9'})
    records = []
    links_discovered = 0
    links_processed = 0
    categories = 0
    seen = set()
    for _, row in input_df.iterrows():
        keyword = value_from_row(row, 'keyword')
        listing_url = value_from_row(row, 'listing_url') or TARGET_URL
        detail_url = value_from_row(row, 'detail_url')
        try:
            if detail_url:
                targets = [(detail_url, 'DIRECT_INPUT')]
            else:
                categories += 1
                targets = [(url, listing_url) for url in discover_links(session, listing_url, keyword)]
            links_discovered += len(targets)
            for url, source in targets:
                if url in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(url)
                if args.max_products is not None and len(records) >= args.max_products:
                    break
                response = fetch(session, url)
                soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
                record = extract_detail(soup, response.url, source, args.mask_reviews)
                links_processed += 1
                if record:
                    records.append(record)
        except RuntimeError as exc:
            add_flag('Error', detail_url or listing_url, str(exc))
            break
        except Exception as exc:
            add_flag('Error', detail_url or listing_url, str(exc))
    log(f'Crawl Funnel: {categories} categories, {links_discovered} links discovered, {links_processed} processed, {len(records)} extracted.')
    if not records:
        diagnostic_url = value_from_row(input_df.iloc[0], 'detail_url') or value_from_row(input_df.iloc[0], 'listing_url') or TARGET_URL
        try:
            response = session.get(diagnostic_url, timeout=30)
            asyncio.run(diagnostic_screenshot(diagnostic_url, response.status_code, response.text, args.headless))
        except Exception as exc:
            add_flag('Error', diagnostic_url, f'Diagnostic capture failed: {exc}')
        log('ERROR: Zero product records were extracted. Aborting.')
        export_results([], args.output)
        sys.exit(1)
    export_results(records, args.output)
    log(f'Wrote {len(records)} records to {args.output}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

            await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); window.chrome = { runtime: {} };")
            await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); window.chrome = { runtime: {} };")
            await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); window.chrome = { runtime: {} };")
            page = await context.new_page()
            for _, row in rows.iterrows():
                if self.stop_for_antibot or (self.args.max_products and len(self.records) >= self.args.max_products):
                    break
                await self.run_row(page, context, row)
            await browser.close()


def read_input(path):
    sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None)
    sheets = {k: v.fillna("") for k, v in sheets.items()}
    input_df = sheets.get("Extracted Data") or next(iter(sheets.values()), pd.DataFrame())
    allowed = {"keyword", "listing_url", "detail_url"}
    if not any(str(c).strip().lower() in allowed for c in input_df.columns):
        input_df = pd.read_excel(path, header=None).fillna("")
        input_df = input_df.rename(columns={input_df.columns[0]: "keyword"})
    input_df.columns = [str(c).strip().lower() for c in input_df.columns]
    for col in allowed:
        if col not in input_df.columns:
            input_df[col] = ""
    return input_df


def export_results(scraper, output):
    columns = [
        "product_id", "product_url", "source_listing_url", "Nº", "Data", "Nome", "Tipologia",
        "Capacidade", "Localização", "Certificações", "RNET nº", "Data de Registo",
        "Tipologia Completa", "Morada e Código Postal", "Contactos", "Marca Comercial",
        "Entidade Exploradora", "NIF / NIPC"
    ]
    data = []
    for record in scraper.records:
        data.append({col: sanitize_cell_value(record.get(col, "")) for col in columns})
    flags = [{k: sanitize_cell_value(v) for k, v in flag.items()} for flag in scraper.flags]
    with pd.ExcelWriter(output, engine="openpyxl") as writer:
        pd.DataFrame(data, columns=columns).to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Extracted Data", index=False)
        pd.DataFrame(flags, columns=["Type", "URL", "Message"]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Flags", index=False)


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="RNET accommodation scraper")
    parser.add_argument("--input", default="input.xlsx")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="output.xlsx")
    parser.add_argument("--max-products", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--headless", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=True)
    parser.add_argument("--mask-reviews", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=True)
    return parser.parse_args()


async def main_async(args):
    rows = read_input(args.input)
    scraper = Scraper(args)
    await scraper.execute(rows)
    log(f"Crawl Funnel: {scraper.categories_discovered} categories, {scraper.links_discovered} links discovered, {scraper.links_processed} processed, {scraper.records_extracted} extracted.")
    if scraper.records_extracted == 0:
        async with async_playwright() as pw:
            browser = await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=["--no-sandbox"])
            page = await browser.new_page()
            response, html = await scraper.goto(page, TARGET_URL)
            status = response.status if response else 0
            title = await page.title()
            await page.screenshot(path="diagnostic_screenshot.png", full_page=True)
            log(f"No product records found: HTTP {status}, Title: '{title}', Screenshot: diagnostic_screenshot.png")
            await browser.close()
        log("ERROR: Zero product records were extracted. Aborting.")
        export_results(scraper, args.output)
        sys.exit(1)
    export_results(scraper, args.output)
    if scraper.stop_for_antibot:
        log("Stopped cleanly due to anti-bot protection.")


def main():
    args = parse_args()
    asyncio.run(main_async(args))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def log(message):

def sanitize_cell_value(val, max_len=32000):
    if val is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(val, (dict, list)):
        s = json.dumps(val, ensure_ascii=False)
    else:
        s = str(val)
    if len(s) > max_len:
        return s[:max_len - 35] + "... [TRUNCATED_EXCEL_LIMIT]"
    return s


def clean(value):
    if value is None or pd.isna(value) or str(value).strip().lower() in ("", "nan", "none", "null"):
        return ""
    try:
        if pd.isna(value):
            return ""
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        pass
    text = str(value).strip()
    if text.lower() in {"nan", "none", "null"}:
        return ""
    return text


def value_from_row(row, key):
    if key not in row.index:
        return ""
    return clean(row[key])


def mask_reviewer_pii(text):
    if not text:
        return text
    text = re.sub(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "***@***.***", text)

    def mask_name(match):
        parts = match.group(0).split()
        return " ".join(f"{p[0]}***" if len(p) > 1 else p for p in parts[:-1]) + (f" {parts[-1][0]}." if parts else "")

    return re.sub(r"\b[A-ZÀ-ÖØ-Ý][a-zà-öø-ÿ]+\s+[A-ZÀ-ÖØ-Ý][a-zà-öø-ÿ]+\b", mask_name, text)

    if match:
        return match.group(1)
    match = re.search(r"RNET\s*n?[ºo]?\s*(\d+)", text or "", re.I)

    markers = (

        "datadome", "perimeterx", "px-captcha", "distil networks", "press & hold",

        "potential security risk", "detected automated scripts", "additional security check",
        "i am human", "hcaptcha", "access denied", "robot or human"

                "Nome": values[2] if len(values) > 2 else "",
                "Tipologia": values[3] if len(values) > 3 else "",
                "Capacidade": values[4] if len(values) > 4 else "",
                "Localização": values[5] if len(values) > 5 else "",
                "Certificações": values[6] if len(values) > 6 else "",
            }
            result.append(item)
        return result

    def detail_value(self, soup, labels):
        labels = [x.lower() for x in labels]
        for row in soup.select("tr"):
            cells = row.find_all(["th", "td"])
            if len(cells) < 2:
                continue
            label = cells[0].get_text(" ", strip=True).lower()
            if any(candidate in label for candidate in labels):
                return cells[1].get_text(" ", strip=True).replace("\xa0", " ")
        return ""

    async def extract_detail(self, context, item, source_listing_url):
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            response, html = await self.goto(page, item["product_url"])
            if self.stop_for_antibot:
                return None
            soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
            safe_title = (soup.title.get_text(strip=True) if getattr(soup, "title", None) else "") if getattr(soup, "title", None) else ""
            detail_table = soup.select_one("#RichWidgets_wt13_block_wtMainContent_wt15_wtShowEmprreendimento")
            full_text = soup.get_text("\n", strip=True).replace("\xa0", " ")
            heading = full_text[:2000]
            registration = extract_registration(item["product_url"], heading) or item["product_id"]
            registered = ""
            match = re.search(r"Registado\s+em\s*[:\-]?\s*([^\n]+)", full_text, re.I)
            if match:
                registered = match.group(1).strip()
            website = ""
            website_link = soup.select_one("#RichWidgets_wt13_block_wtMainContent_wt15_wt247")
            if website_link:
                website = website_link.get("href") or website_link.get_text(" ", strip=True)
            contacts = self.detail_value(soup, ["contactos"])
            if website and website not in contacts:
                contacts = f"{contacts}; {website}" if contacts else website
            operating = ""
            match = re.search(r"Entidade\s+exploradora\s*[:\-]?\s*([^\n]+)", full_text, re.I)
            if match:
                operating = match.group(1).strip()
            nif = ""
            match = re.search(r"(?:NIF|NIPC)\s*[:\-]?\s*(\d[\d .-]{7,})", full_text, re.I)
            if match:
                nif = re.sub(r"\s+", "", match.group(1)).strip(".-")
            record = dict(item)
            record.update({
                "product_id": registration,
                "RNET nº": registration,
                "Data de Registo": registered,
                "Tipologia Completa": self.detail_value(soup, ["tipologia"]) or item.get("Tipologia", ""),
                "Morada e Código Postal": self.detail_value(soup, ["morada", "localização", "localizacao"]),
                "Contactos": contacts,
                "Marca Comercial": self.detail_value(soup, ["marca comercial", "marca"]),
                "Entidade Exploradora": operating,
                "NIF / NIPC": nif,
            })
            if not detail_table:
                self.flag("Low-confidence extraction", item["product_url"], "Expected detail table was not found")
            for field in ["Tipologia Completa", "Morada e Código Postal", "Contactos", "Marca Comercial", "Entidade Exploradora", "NIF / NIPC"]:
                if not record.get(field):
                    self.flag("Missing field", item["product_url"], f"Missing {field}")
            if self.args.mask_reviews:
                for key, value in list(record.items()):
                    if "review" in key.lower() or "review" in str(value).lower():
                        record[key] = mask_reviewer_pii(value)
            return record
        finally:
            await page.close()

    async def crawl_listing(self, page, context, listing_url, keyword=""):
        response, html = await self.goto(page, listing_url)
        if self.stop_for_antibot:
            return
        if keyword:
            input_selector = "#RichWidgets_wt104_block_wtMainContent_wtInput_FiltroTexto"
            submit_selector = "#RichWidgets_wt104_block_wtMainContent_wt201"
            try:
                await page.wait_for_selector(input_selector, timeout=30000)
                await page.locator(input_selector).fill(keyword)
                submit = page.locator(submit_selector)
                if not await self.safe_click(page, submit, submit_selector, page.url):
                    return
                await self.wait_results(page)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.flag("Error", page.url, f"Search failed: {exc}")
                return
        while not self.stop_for_antibot:
            source_url = page.url
            items = await self.parse_listing_page(page, source_url)
            self.links_discovered += len(items)
            self.categories_discovered += 1
            for item in items:
                if self.args.max_products and len(self.records) >= self.args.max_products:
                    return
                detail = await self.extract_detail(context, item, source_url)
                self.links_processed += 1
                if detail:
                    self.records.append(detail)
                    self.records_extracted += 1
            next_locator = page.locator(".ListNavigation_Next").first
            try:
                if not await next_locator.count() or not await next_locator.is_visible():
                    break
                disabled = await next_locator.get_attribute("aria-disabled")
                classes = await next_locator.get_attribute("class") or ""
                if disabled == "true" or "disabled" in classes.lower() or not await next_locator.get_attribute("href"):
                    break
                if not await self.safe_click(page, next_locator, ".ListNavigation_Next", page.url):
                    break
                await self.wait_results(page)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.flag("Error", page.url, f"Pagination failed: {exc}")
                break

    async def run_row(self, page, context, row):
        detail_url = value_from_row(row, "detail_url")
        listing_url = value_from_row(row, "listing_url") or TARGET_URL
        keyword = value_from_row(row, "keyword")
        if detail_url:
            url = urljoin(TARGET_URL, detail_url)
            item = {"product_id": extract_registration(url), "product_url": url, "source_listing_url": "DIRECT_INPUT", "Nº": extract_registration(url)}
            detail = await self.extract_detail(context, item, "DIRECT_INPUT")
            if detail:
                self.records.append(detail)
                self.links_processed += 1
                self.records_extracted += 1
            return
        await self.crawl_listing(page, context, listing_url, keyword)

    async def execute(self, rows):
        async with async_playwright() as pw:
            browser = await pw.chromium.launch(headless=self.args.headless, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"])
            context = await browser.new_context(
                user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/124 Safari/537.36",
                viewport={"width": 1920, "height": 1080},
            )
            await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); window.chrome = { runtime: {} };")
            await context.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); window.chrome = { runtime: {} };")
            page = await context.new_page()
            for _, row in rows.iterrows():
                if self.stop_for_antibot or (self.args.max_products and len(self.records) >= self.args.max_products):
                    break
                await self.run_row(page, context, row)
            await browser.close()


def read_input(path):
    sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None)
    sheets = {k: v.fillna("") for k, v in sheets.items()}
    input_df = sheets.get("Extracted Data") or next(iter(sheets.values()), pd.DataFrame())
    allowed = {"keyword", "listing_url", "detail_url"}
    if not any(str(c).strip().lower() in allowed for c in input_df.columns):
        input_df = pd.read_excel(path, header=None).fillna("")
        input_df = input_df.rename(columns={input_df.columns[0]: "keyword"})
    input_df.columns = [str(c).strip().lower() for c in input_df.columns]
    for col in allowed:
        if col not in input_df.columns:
            input_df[col] = ""
    return input_df


def export_results(scraper, output):
    columns = [
        "product_id", "product_url", "source_listing_url", "Nº", "Data", "Nome", "Tipologia",
        "Capacidade", "Localização", "Certificações", "RNET nº", "Data de Registo",
        "Tipologia Completa", "Morada e Código Postal", "Contactos", "Marca Comercial",
        "Entidade Exploradora", "NIF / NIPC"
    ]
    data = []
    for record in scraper.records:
        data.append({col: sanitize_cell_value(record.get(col, "")) for col in columns})
    flags = [{k: sanitize_cell_value(v) for k, v in flag.items()} for flag in scraper.flags]
    with pd.ExcelWriter(output, engine="openpyxl") as writer:
        pd.DataFrame(data, columns=columns).to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Extracted Data", index=False)
        pd.DataFrame(flags, columns=["Type", "URL", "Message"]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Flags", index=False)


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="RNET accommodation scraper")
    parser.add_argument("--input", default="input.xlsx")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="output.xlsx")
    parser.add_argument("--max-products", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--headless", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=True)
    parser.add_argument("--mask-reviews", action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=True)
    return parser.parse_args()


async def main_async(args):
    rows = read_input(args.input)
    scraper = Scraper(args)
    await scraper.execute(rows)
    log(f"Crawl Funnel: {scraper.categories_discovered} categories, {scraper.links_discovered} links discovered, {scraper.links_processed} processed, {scraper.records_extracted} extracted.")
    if scraper.records_extracted == 0:
        async with async_playwright() as pw:
            browser = await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=["--no-sandbox"])
            page = await browser.new_page()
            response, html = await scraper.goto(page, TARGET_URL)
            status = response.status if response else 0
            title = await page.title()
            await page.screenshot(path="diagnostic_screenshot.png", full_page=True)
            log(f"No product records found: HTTP {status}, Title: '{title}', Screenshot: diagnostic_screenshot.png")
            await browser.close()
        log("ERROR: Zero product records were extracted. Aborting.")
        export_results(scraper, args.output)
        sys.exit(1)
    export_results(scraper, args.output)
    if scraper.stop_for_antibot:
        log("Stopped cleanly due to anti-bot protection.")


def main():
    args = parse_args()
    asyncio.run(main_async(args))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

0cb7daad-21ad-4a81-be2c-ddee602bd931.search_rules:

* For each keyword:

0cb7daad-21ad-4a81-be2c-ddee602bd931.navigation_rules:
* For each search result row on the current page:
  1. Extract the listing row data.
  2. Locate the detail page link (the '+' icon / registration link with href*='RNET.aspx?nr=').
  3. Open the detail page URL in a separate page tab (context.new_page()), extract all detail fields, and close the tab. This ensures the search table state and pagination are not reset.
* Pagination:
  1. After processing all rows on the current page, locate the "próximo" pagination link (.ListNavigation_Next).
  2. If the "próximo" link exists, is visible, and is not disabled (aria-disabled != 'true' and no 'disabled' class):
     - Click "próximo".
     - Wait for the AJAX update to finish and for the next set of rows to load.
     - Repeat the extraction for the new page.
  3. If "próximo" is absent, disabled, or if 0 rows are found on the page, stop pagination for this keyword.
* Once all result pages for the current keyword are finished, proceed to the next keyword from Column A of the input file.
